_comment: Repo-tracked CURATED tuning catalog for custom Orpheus voices. Machine-independent (folder name + token + tuning only — the models ROOT is resolved per-machine). This file is the AUTHORITATIVE source for per-voice tuning and OVERLAYS the per-machine runtime install manifest (models.json in the models dir): the runtime manifest records what is installed WHERE (dir/token/addedAt, written by the installer); this catalog overrides the curated tuning fields (label, token, caps, backends, postRenderFilter, sentenceGap, measuredSentenceGapS, ...). Catalog wins for any field it declares. Commit + push to propagate identical tuning to every machine (Windows/WSL/Mac). measuredSentenceGapS = the natural inter-sentence gap MEASURED from the training source (end-of-word to start-of-next-word, chapter gaps >2s excluded) — the target 'we are shooting for'. sentenceGap = the tuned ASSEMBLY-time inject; set it only after a generation probe shows how much the model self-produces. modelSelfTailS = the TRAILING silence the model emits on its own - THIS, not the internal gap, is what an inject stacks onto (confusing the two is exactly how thirdreich ended up 0.24s long on every join). modelInternalGapS = the gap the model leaves BETWEEN sentences inside one packed chunk, i.e. its own sentence rhythm and the thing a chunk join should imitate. Measure both with orpheus-finetune/pipeline/measure_sentence_gaps.py against any rendered sentence cache; choose sentenceGap so that (modelSelfTailS + sentenceGap) ~= 0.75 * modelInternalGapS, where the ear-approved deathstalker sits. RE-MEASURE AFTER EVERY RETRAIN - corpus tail trimming changes modelSelfTailS directly. Absent sentenceGap => untested => the assembly page shows the 0.6s universal default (DEFAULT_SENTENCE_GAP).
_artifactComment: base/adapterDir/dir describe WHERE a voice's two artifact forms live; 'artifact' is an optional PIN and is normally ABSENT. A voice ships in BOTH forms and both are expected on disk: a full 6.6 GB merged fine-tune in <models>/<dir>/ (HF <voice>-orpheus-3b) and a ~0.4 GB LoRA in <models>/adapters/<adapterDir>/ (HF <voice>-orpheus-3b-lora) served on the ONE shared base in <models>/_base/<short-name-of base.ref>/, passed to e2a as --orpheus_base_dir + --orpheus_adapter_dir. WHICH ONE SERVES DEPENDS ON THE CALLER'S PURPOSE, not on this file: the batch audiobook workers take the MERGED copy (one voice per process, hours of decode, and fused weights skip the 196 extra rank-64 GEMMs per token that vLLM's LoRA path adds), while the resident streaming server takes whatever tool-paths.json's orpheusStreamingArtifact says — MERGED by default since 2026-08-10 (the ~10-20% per-token cost of the LoRA path outweighs the warm voice switch it bought; set 'adapter' to restore warm switching and per-request casting). See OrpheusServePurpose in electron/orpheus-models.ts. Setting 'artifact' here OVERRIDES that routing for the voice and is why it is normally omitted — it was removed from thirdreich/mistborn/deathstalker on 2026-08-10 precisely because pinning 'adapter' forced every audiobook render down the LoRA path. When only one form is on disk that one is served regardless, which is safe because the two forms are the SAME WEIGHTS (verified 2026-08-09 by range-reading the deployed merged checkpoints against a local fuse of base+adapter: 28.3 M sampled elements per voice, zero differing). What is NEVER allowed is serving the merged copy because an adapter's BASE is missing: that throws, because the substitution would be inaudible until someone A/B'd the whole book. Voices with no adapter (owen, ender) simply have no adapters/ folder and always serve merged.

models.label: Third Reich (Sean Pratt)

mlx._note: 2026-08-21: MLX boost port trial. Same pair as backends.vllm — the ramp arithmetic is identical, but the MLX port (orpheus.py _mlx_eos_boost_processor) clamps the start to 0.9*MLX_MAX_TOKENS (~3,330), because at eosBoostStart 2.0 a 500-char chunk's natural start (~4,600) sits past the 3,700 cap and the boost could never fire for exactly the rows that still cap (2 in 623 chunks after the rep-window fix, both ~500-char slow-delivery passages; the window fix took cap hits 52 -> 2, this targets the residue). Legit-slowest 500-char render is ~3,050 tokens (p05 13.78 ch/s), under the clamped start. Listen-gate before trusting: a boost firing at 3,330 touches only renders already past the legitimate slow tail, but nobody has EAR-checked a boosted MLX render yet.

models._maxCharsNote: 500 (2026-07-27), raised from the 350 default in core.py. That default carries the note '450 fails everywhere — keep the cap ≤~350', but that verdict was reached on 2026-07-12 against rohan-v2, which the SAME comment calls a broken training recipe (38s clips / max_seq_length 4096 → 19% runaway). The way 450 failed was EOS failure — chunks reaching the 3700-token cap without emitting end-of-audio — which is exactly the defect tr_ownbed1_ep248 eliminated (0 failures in 1500 chunks, 900 boost-off + 600 boosted). So the old verdict is stale evidence for this checkpoint and is being re-tested on a Witnesses re-run. HEADROOM: 3700 audio tokens ÷ 84 tok/s = 44.0 s; at the measured worst case (~450 chars needing up to 3400 tokens) MEASURED from 1928 real renders: the p05 (slowest) rate is 13.78 ch/s, so the 44.0 s budget is exhausted at ~540 chars and 500 uses ~93% of it at that worst-case rate (71% at median). The old ~8-tokens-per-char rule of thumb was ~40% conservative. Anything overshooting now hits the early-truncation guard and re-renders split. Raising ORPHEUS_MAX_TOKENS toward ~3950 (the 4096 context minus prompt) would buy ~500-520. Beyond that needs max_model_len > 4096, i.e. running the model past its 2048 fine-tuning length — untested. REVERT: delete this key to fall back to 350. NOTE maxChars is a PREP cap, so a book must be re-prepped, not just re-rendered.
models.note: tr_v2 ep366 (Owen's 2026-07-28 Adobe+FCPX-EQ 8 h export -> resplit on split_map_8h -> Owen's room tone bed at -70 dBFS; 3.00 h / 797 clips, verbatim tails, NO smile EQ because the EQ is already in the export). Promoted 2026-07-28 on Owen's ear over ep183/ep549. WHY ep366: on the chapter-heading probe it tracks the narrator's deliberate delivery (13.3 ch/s against his 12.9) where ep183 runs 30% fast at 16.8; all four safe epochs were within 0.4 dB of each other on tilt, so pacing decided it. Greedy EOS gate 20/20 and ZERO cap hits / zero EOS failures across all 100 battery renders. eval_loss 3.5248 (min was ep549 at 3.5182, a 0.0066 difference = noise on 66 eval clips). CORPUS CHANGE worth knowing: this export is 4.6 dB darker at 5-7k and 5.9 dB at 7-9k than tr_ownbed70's smile-EQ'd corpus - a deliberate, warmer voice, and the same direction that killed the static on deathstalker mm_v3. Pause floor is unchanged (p50 -69.7 vs -69.6) because the bed sets it; the raw export's own floor is -95.5 dBFS, i.e. sterile, which is exactly why the bed is not optional here. DEFINITIVE 2026-07-28: deployed to WSL + HF + Mac, all three verified byte-identical by SHA-256 (model-00001 c76afb54febdbb57, model-00002 0921316a85522c80, tokenizer fc3fecb199b41706). HF history squashed to ONE commit so superseded weights do not accumulate. EVERY earlier thirdreich checkpoint is DELETED at Owen's instruction (tr_ownbed70 ep366, thirdreich_pre_tt1, tr_ae2_ep132/396/528, and the tr_v2 siblings ep183/549/732/915) - there is NO fallback copy anywhere. To go back, retrain: the corpus E:/training/thirdreich/build/tr_v2_ownbed and the pool tr_ae8h_v2 are both on disk, and the build is deterministic (see _repro/ and TESTING_BIBLE).
models._gapNote: Source (Sean Pratt, nonfiction) inter-sentence gap: median 1.43s over 4725 prose boundaries (>2s section gaps excluded; ~1.23s at a tighter <=1.5s cap that drops paragraph pauses). GENERATED-gap probe 2026-07-23 (orpheus-render, pad off): the model self-produces ~0.5s natural gap — same as deathstalker/mistborn/ender, a base-model/recipe property, NOT learned per-narrator. Chose sentenceGap 0.3 => ~0.8s assembled, matching the other narrators' feel; full source-match (~+0.9s to reach 1.4s) risks a draggy/mechanical cadence. A/B against 0 owed. SUPERSEDED 2026-07-25 (tr_tt1 ep420, measure_sentence_gaps.py, 400 clips of the Witnesses render): the 0.3 arithmetic added the inject to the WRONG QUANTITY. The ~0.5s figure above is the model's INTERNAL inter-sentence gap, but an inject stacks onto the clip's TRAILING silence, and that measures 0.74s (p10 0.26 / p90 0.99). So 0.3 produced 1.04s joins, not the intended ~0.8s - 1.76x this model's own sentence rhythm (internal gap 0.59s). sentenceGap 0.0 leaves joins at 0.74s, which IS the originally intended target. Calibration: the ear-approved deathstalker sits at 0.31s tail vs 0.42s internal = 0.74x; thirdreich cannot reach that ratio by inject alone because its bare tail already exceeds it. CROSS-VALIDATED two ways: the 20-clip loop-gate render of ep420 (raw, no baked gap) gives tail 0.755s / internal 0.565s against the 400-clip e2a cache figures of 0.740s / 0.590s - agreement within 0.03s, which confirms both the method and the 0.6s baked-gap assumption used to derive the cache numbers.
models._rateNote: RE-MEASURED 2026-07-28 for tr_v2 ep366 on its own 20-chunk epoch_battery render (raw, no assembly pad), same measure_voice_rate.py metric: rate p05 14.27 / median 15.46 / p99 17.22 ch/s -> p99 x1.15 = 19.8. maxCharsPerSec is nevertheless HELD AT 21.6. Reason: 19.8 comes from 20 probe chunks, while the NARRATOR's own p99 over all 797 corpus clips is 21.65 ch/s - so a 19.8 cap sits BELOW the delivery rate this voice was trained to reproduce and would fire on correct audio the moment the model imitates one of his fast passages. The cap exists to catch a render that is too fast for its text; it must clear the narrator's p99, not the model's probe median. 21.6 also has real-book evidence behind it (1 truncation in 1151 chunks of The Mysterious Stranger). Revisit off a full book render, not off 20 chunks. Prior value derivation (tr_ownbed70 ep366): p05 14.04 / median 16.53 / p99 18.77 -> 21.6. maxChars measured ceiling 550 but HELD AT 500 - 500 has real-book evidence, 550 has only arithmetic.
models._minChunkGapNote: FLOOR on chunk trailing silence, added 2026-07-27 after Owen heard chunk joins colliding in The Mysterious Stranger. With sentenceGap 0.0 the join IS the model own trained tail, and that tail varies: measured over 1151 chunks, median 0.81 s but p10 0.39 s and MIN 0.00 s. An additive gap would have fixed the collisions and stretched the 78%% that were already right; this tops up only the clips below the floor. 0.55 s matches the within-chunk sentence rhythm (0.58 s measured), so a chunk boundary never sounds tighter than a sentence boundary inside one. Cost: ~22%% of chunks lifted by a mean 0.18 s, +45 s over a 4-hour book. Applied at assembly by normalize_gaps.py; RE-MEASURE after a retrain, since tail geometry moves with the corpus.
models._promotionNote: 2026-08-28: model replaced by tr_pc1_ep732 (tr_v2_ownbed with internal pauses soft-knee capped; bible 08-28). Book-validated: zero inside-chunk pauses >=2 s, zero guard fires. maxCharsPerSec 21.6->22.0 (corpus p99 19.10 +15%); modelSelfTailS 1.17->1.05 (measured on the WTF render, 0.6 pad subtracted). Local-only promotion; HF/Mac swap pending Owen's book runs.

models.label: Mistborn (Michael Kramer)

vllm._eosFloorNote: 2026-09-03, Owen's go. EOS forbidden below 0.65 x (chars / 15 ch/s x 84 tok/s), i.e. on any read faster than 23.1 ch/s (clears the 22.0 guard). MEASURED on the mb 240-draw battery, same seeds: floor 0 / 0.55 / 0.65 -> truncations 8 / 6 / 4 with loops 0 / 0 / 0; at 0.65 every survivor is an over-length text (>430 ch), so in-range early stops are ZERO. Growth on non-defect draws (2/240) re-rendered alone was token-identical with and without the floor = batch reshuffle, not the floor; audio complete, 0 extra tail words. Per-model on purpose: thirdreich leans to loops, not truncations, and carries no floor. eosFloorRate left at the 15.0 default (measured median 14.99).

models.note: mb_ae2 ep327 (Hero of Ages 2h, Adobe Enhance v2 75p voice-only with background and music at 100p, then Owen's own EQ, level-matched to the source with headroom). Promoted 2026-07-25 and deployed to HF + Mac, REPLACING mb_hoa1 ep344 everywhere. Chosen where three independent criteria agreed: Owen's ear on a 96s mixed narration+dialogue render, eval-min of the run (3.8214 vs 4.0640 for the untreated hoa3p0h corpus), and a clean greedy EOS gate 20/20. NOT ep545 - it scored closest on measurable fidelity but is the single epoch that FAILED the greedy gate, a chunk hitting the 3700-token cap. The corpus is 4.8 dB brighter than source (tilt -26.6 vs -31.7), which is the win, and 5.3 dB more silence-suppressed (SNR 54.6 vs 49.3), which is the residual risk: token overrun still runs 1.36x median / 1.46x p90. sentenceGap 0.0 because the 1.18s self-tail already exceeds the 0.75x-internal target of 0.50s.
models._gapNote: Measured 2026-07-23 from The Final Empire (Michael Kramer): prose inter-sentence gap median 0.80s / mean 0.75s over 9397 narration boundaries (dialogue excluded; chapter gaps >2s excluded). Cross-checked against Alloy of Law (same narrator): identical prose median 0.80s — confirms book-exact. sentenceGap (inject) left unset pending a generation probe. NOTE the 0.80s above is The Final Empire, the WRONG BOOK for this slot: on 2026-07-25 mistborn was promoted to mb_hoa1 ep344, trained on HERO OF AGES. PROBE DONE 2026-07-25 from the 20-clip loop-gate render of ep344 itself (measure_sentence_gaps.py, raw renders so no baked trail_gap): modelSelfTailS 0.975s, modelInternalGapS 0.540s. Left at the 0.6s default a chunk join would be 1.575s = 2.9x this model's own sentence rhythm, so sentenceGap is set to 0.0, giving 0.975s joins. The 0.75x target (0.41s) is UNREACHABLE by inject here because the bare tail alone is 0.975s - ep344 was trained WITHOUT the Step 5b tail scaling that thirdreich got, and its tail spread is wide (p10 0.46 / p90 1.58). A future mb retrain should scale tails; until then 0.0 is the best available. CONFIRM on the first full Hellworld cache - 20 clips is a small sample, though every percentile of it already rules out any positive inject.
models._rateNote: MEASURED 2026-07-27 by pipeline/measure_voice_rate.py from Hellworld (1069 cached sentences >150 chars), replicating orpheus.py::_speech_rate exactly (chars / trim_audio(0.01, 0.20) seconds). Rate p05 11.81 / median 14.99 / p99 19.03 ch/s. maxCharsPerSec = p99 x1.15 (above every healthy render, below a truncation which roughly doubles the rate). maxChars = the real token budget (3700 tok / 84 tok-per-s = 44.0 s) x the p05 (SLOWEST) rate x0.90 safety - a slow reader fits fewer characters in the same 44 s, which is why these differ per voice.
